Container.Name: media-vault
Container.Overview:
⚠ SETUP FIRST: media-vault needs a separate PostgreSQL 16 database — install a "postgres:16-alpine" container first, then set this container's DB Host/Port/Name/User/Password to point at it.
A self-hosted, open-source catalog for physical media (games, movies, vinyl, CDs) with automatic cover/rating/description enrichment and a signature spine-shelf view.
📖 Full setup guide (install, get the free artwork keys, add them in the app): https://github.com/halvar20000/media-vault/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
Container.Description:
⚠ REQUIRES A SEPARATE POSTGRESQL 16 CONTAINER. Before installing media-vault, add a "postgres:16-alpine" container (set POSTGRES_USER / POSTGRES_PASSWORD / POSTGRES_DB), then fill in the DB Host/Port/Name/User/Password fields below to match it. media-vault will not start without a reachable database.
media-vault catalogs your physical media collection and auto-fetches cover art, ratings and descriptions per media type (IGDB for games, TMDB for movies, Discogs for vinyl/CD).
FIRST LOGIN: use the "Login email" and "Login password" you set below (defaults admin@media-vault.local / changeme). The Session Secret can be left blank — it's generated automatically.
Container.Requires:
A PostgreSQL 16 database. Install a postgres:16-alpine container first (set POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB) and link it via the DB variables below.
Step-by-step setup guide: https://github.com/halvar20000/media-vault/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the app is reached on.

Config.Name: Covers Volume
Config.Description: Where cached cover images are stored.

Config.Name: DB Host
Config.Description: Postgres container IP or hostname.

Config.Name: DB Port
Config.Description: Postgres port.

Config.Name: DB Name
Config.Description: Database name.

Config.Name: DB User
Config.Description: Database user.

Config.Name: DB Password
Config.Description: Database password.

Config.Name: Session Secret (optional)
Config.Description: Leave BLANK — one is auto-generated and saved on first boot. Only set this if you want to supply your own long random string (e.g. from: openssl rand -base64 32).

Config.Name: App Origin
Config.Description: Public URL of the app (e.g. http://TOWER-IP:8080).

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Let new users self-register. Keep false on an exposed instance.

Config.Name: Marketplace
Config.Description: Which second-hand marketplace(s) the 'find deals / bundles' buttons search. Comma-separated — each value adds its own button (e.g. leboncoin,medimops,kleinanzeigen). Values: leboncoin (France), kleinanzeigen (Germany), ebay-de, ebay-com, ebay-uk, ebay-fr, marktplaats (Netherlands), wallapop (Spain), medimops (German used-media shop), easycash (French used-goods shop), or none to hide the buttons.

Config.Name: Easy Cash store
Config.Description: Optional: pin Easy Cash 'find deal' links to one physical store. Use the store's exact facet value (department + name), e.g. '68 - Mulhouse'. Blank = all stores / full online catalogue.

Config.Name: Craigslist city
Config.Description: US only: Craigslist is per-city. Set your site subdomain, e.g. newyork, sfbay, losangeles. Required for Craigslist links (no national search). Blank = Craigslist hidden. (Also settable in the app's Settings panel.)

Config.Name: HTTPS (production cookies)
Config.Description: Set to 'production' ONLY behind HTTPS (reverse proxy); otherwise leave 'development'.

Config.Name: Login email
Config.Description: The admin account created on first boot — this is the email you log in with. Change it or keep the default.

Config.Name: Login password
Config.Description: Password for the login above (created on first boot). CHANGE THIS from 'changeme', especially if the instance is reachable outside your LAN.

Config.Name: IGDB Client ID
Config.Description: Twitch app Client ID (games).

Config.Name: IGDB Client Secret
Config.Description: Twitch app Client Secret (games).

Config.Name: TMDB Access Token
Config.Description: TMDB v4 Read Access Token (movies).

Config.Name: TMDB Language
Config.Description: Movie metadata language, e.g. de-DE.

Config.Name: Discogs Key
Config.Description: Discogs consumer key (vinyl/CD).

Config.Name: Discogs Secret
Config.Description: Discogs consumer secret (vinyl/CD).

Config.Name: PriceCharting Token
Config.Description: PAID PriceCharting API token for game valuation (optional; eBay below is a free alternative). Music valuation uses Discogs; movies have no price source.

Config.Name: eBay Client ID (App ID)
Config.Description: FREE game valuation via eBay. Register an app at developer.ebay.com (Production keyset) and paste the App ID here. When set, games are valued from eBay used-listing prices (takes priority over PriceCharting).

Config.Name: eBay Client Secret (Cert ID)
Config.Description: eBay Cert ID (Client Secret) that pairs with the App ID above.

Config.Name: eBay Marketplace
Config.Description: Which eBay site/currency to price against: EBAY_DE (EUR), EBAY_FR (EUR), EBAY_GB (GBP), EBAY_US (USD), EBAY_IT, EBAY_ES…

Config.Name: Valuation Currency
Config.Description: Currency for Discogs marketplace prices (EUR, USD, GBP…).
